Topics · Death and what comes after

Why test us instead of simply making us good?

Programmed goodness is not chosen. That is only part of it: the cost is huge, and no complete answer is known.

Part 1 of 3

﴿إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا٢ إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture[1811] that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing. Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

Translator's notes

[1811] i.e., a combination of the male and female substance, within the womb.

Original · Hebrew

רְאֵ֨ה נָתַ֤תִּי לְפָנֶ֨יךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־הַֽחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַטּ֑וֹב וְאֶת־הַמָּ֖וֶת וְאֶת־הָרָֽע׃ הַעִידֹ֨תִי בָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ֒ הַחַיִּ֤ים וְהַמָּ֨וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הַבְּרָכָ֖ה וְהַקְּלָלָ֑ה וּבָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּֽחַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃

the Torah (Deuteronomy) · 30:15, 19

World English Bible

A God who knows everything needs no experiment, so 'test' cannot mean finding out the result. Take your second question. Could a person be made good? A machine can be set to do kind things, but we do not call it kind. Goodness as we mean it involves being able to do otherwise, and choosing. A world of beings who could not fail would lack that goodness. This verse describes this: hearing, sight, a way shown, and two paths left open.

A question for you

Could there be goodness without the possibility of doing wrong?

If you sayNo. Goodness needs choice.
ThenThen a world of choice has a price, and that comes next.
If you sayYes. We could have been made free and never err.
ThenThat is the reply of the philosopher J. L. Mackie, and it is strong. It is not finally answered here.
If you sayI don't think my freedom is real at all.
ThenThat is a large question, and it has its place.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا٩ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا١٠﴾

Translation of the meaning

Translation

He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

Original · Hebrew

נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃

the Psalms · 24:4

World English Bible

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion[1891] and will meet it.[1892]

Translator's notes

[1891] i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death. [1892] i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

Quran · Al-Inshiqaq 84:6

So what is the word 'test' doing? Perhaps it is less like an exam and more like the way hardship reveals and forms a person. These verses say something about this: the one who grows the soul succeeds, and the one who buries it fails. Human beings are described as labouring toward a meeting. On this reading life is less a trap for catching people and more the place where someone becomes who they are. The test shows you to yourself. God already knows.

A question for you

What best describes your reaction to this picture?

If you sayThere is something true about growth in it.
ThenThat is what it stands on, no more.
If you sayMany are broken, not grown.
ThenThat is so, and it is the real limit of this picture. It does not answer that.
If you sayI do not accept being in anyone's experiment.
ThenThat is yours to say, and nothing on this page silences that refusal.

Original · Hebrew

וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל־אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־לָֽךְ׃

1 Chronicles · 29:17

World English Bible

Here the answer stops. This verse says life and death exist to show who is best in deed, and it ends on forgiveness. It does not answer why this much pain. Nobody asked to be born. A good account of choice does not cover a child's suffering. Saying that it does would be false, and cruel. So no complete answer is known. The question stands, and asking it is honest.

A question for you

What question stays with you after all this?
